venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU — the snaps that explain the night
dek: Put the tape on. Here is what Faulkner is asking, what White is asking, and why the play looks like that.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — Charles has not approved publish. Fan rail stays empty.
headline: Faulkner is trying to run Baugh until the defense sits, then throw the easy one. White is trying to take the deep ball away and tackle the short one. Watch the snaps. That is the whole night.

offense.kicker: Buster Faulkner — put the tape on
offense.body:
Philo in the shotgun. Baugh next to him. Three receivers split out. One tight end on the line. That is the picture almost every time they huddle and break. Faulkner is not trying to trick you with the formation. He is trying to stretch the defense so they cannot put eight in the box and still cover Brown, Wilson, and Stockton.

Watch Baugh on first down. The line steps. The first hole is there or it is not. If it is there, he hits it. If the front clogs, he plants and bounces. That bounce is the play. The 18-yarder and the 61 are the same idea — the end crashes, Baugh is already gone outside. When they get inside the 10, watch the guard. Somebody pulls. Now it is downhill. Pad through the pile. That is the 6-yard score. Faulkner told you in the spring he would run it when the whole stadium knew. That is what this is.

Now watch what that does to FAU. They start sitting for Baugh. The corner is off. Philo’s job on the next snap is get it out now. Brown, short right, catch at midfield — that is not a bomb. That is hitch. First man misses. Brown runs 49. Wilson’s first downs are the same throw to the other side. If they get you in the red zone and the corner is trailing, it is fade. Stockton, back pylon, toe on the line. Philo puts it where only he can get it.

When the safety finally cheats down because Baugh has been killing them, Faulkner takes the lid off. Extra bodies in to protect. Abrams runs by everybody down the right sideline. 63 yards. Later Brown, same side, 33. That shot only exists because the run was real. He does not open the game hunting it.

Fourth-and-goal from the 3. Nobody in the backfield. Five out. Watch the ends. Faulkner emptied it on purpose — he wants to see if they climb the pocket. They do. Contain is gone. Philo walks in. That keep is live because of how he lined them up.

Brown also runs one to the left. Same idea as the hitch: they are so worried about him catching it that he becomes the run. Clark comes in when Baugh is done and finishes drives. Jones Jr. closes.

What you should take from this: Faulkner’s offense is not a trick show. Stretch them. Run Baugh. When they sit, throw it now. When they cheat, go over the top.
bullets: Shotgun, Baugh, three wide. Stretch the field so they cannot load the box.
Baugh: hit the hole or bounce. In the red zone, a puller and downhill.
When they sit for the run, hitch. Brown’s 49 is a short catch and a miss.
When the safety cheats, go. Abrams 63. That shot is earned.
Empty at the 3: the ends climb, Philo keeps. That is why he emptied it.

defense.kicker: Brad White — put the tape on
defense.body:
Four down. Two linebackers. An extra defensive back over the slot. That is White vs a spread team. FAU does not huddle. They throw it short and they run it later. White’s answer is: do not get beat deep, rush four, tackle the five-yard throw.

First drive. Third-and-10. Veltkamp in the shotgun, nobody next to him. White does not send the house. Four rush. Everybody else drops. The ball comes out late. Coleman is sitting in the throwing lane. Drive over at the Florida 6. That is the call working. Make him hold it. Take it.

Same idea after Baugh scores. Heat up the middle. Veltkamp throws off his back foot. Johnson goes up and gets it. Coleman is on the breakup. Two takeaways. Four rushers. He is waiting, not gambling.

Now the snaps he loses, because those are the jobs.

Goal line. White packs everybody in. He is saying there is no bounce, you have to win this yard. Ervin still gets in. The box was right. They lost the pile.

Third-and-goal. Four rush again. Veltkamp feels it, leaves, dives the pylon. Watch the end. His job is stay outside and keep the quarterback in. He does not. That score is contain. Not a scheme surprise. A missed job.

Late, Valsin on the fade. All night the corners have been sitting off so nothing goes over their head. That is the point of the defense. Then they fade you. Flowers has to win the back line. He does not. Same play Stockton ran the other way.

In between those scores, FAU just keeps throwing hitch, flat, out. Five yards. Six. Eight. White is living with that. Get off the field on third. When the slot is late or the tackle is missed, that five becomes a first down. That is how you get two interceptions and still feel sloppy. Sumrall called it atrocious at times. This is what he means. The deep ball was dead. The short one kept moving.

Graham is the linebacker running to the hole. McCloud is the push inside that makes the quarterback uncomfortable. Bett finally finishes a rush in the fourth and the ball comes out.

What you should take from this: White will give you the short throw to kill the explosive. The jobs that have to be cleaner are the slot, the tackle, and the end who cannot let the quarterback out.
bullets: Four down, extra DB on the slot. Do not get beat deep. Tackle the short one.
Third-and-10: four rush, Coleman in the lane. That is the wait paying off.
Johnson’s pick is the same idea — heat, duck, go get it.
They lose when the pile loses, the end leaves the pylon, or the fade wins the back line.
Campbell will throw the short one and run the quarterback. Same two jobs.

specials.body: Fourth-and-4 from the FAU 35. They can go for it. They let Durkin try it from 53 instead. Clean. 17–0. Florida never punts.

keys: Faulkner: stretch them, run Baugh, throw it now when they sit, go when they cheat.
Empty at the 3 is him asking the ends to climb. They do. Philo walks in.
White: four rush, no deep ball. Coleman and Johnson are that plan.
The sloppy part is the short throw they agreed to live with, plus contain and the fade.
Campbell: hitch and the quarterback run. Slot and the edge.

nextWeek.look: They will go fast and throw it short. Faulkner will still run Baugh until they sit. White will still rush four. The snaps that matter are the hitch and whether the end stays home.
